name: POST /api/dialer/calls/:call_id/amd - Report answering-machine detection
description: The carrier's answering-machine result for an ACTIVE outbound call (dialing / ringing / in progress), reported by the voice runtime or the telephony connector (e6ae5703-37a6-4d27-a7d5-23ec80c4a001#AC1 — when a machine answers, the campaign's voicemail policy (drop or hang up) is applied and answered_by is recorded). Body: answered_by (human | machine | unknown). Records answered_by on the call and returns the decision {action, message, policy_source}: human or unknown -> connect (a live person is never dropped on); machine -> the campaign's voicemail_policy — drop_tts (message = the campaign's voicemail_message), drop_recording (message = the recording reference) or hang_up — and the call's disposition becomes voicemail with voicemail_action recorded. API calls without a campaign use DIALER_DEFAULT_VOICEMAIL_POLICY (default hang_up). Repeating the same report is idempotent; a conflicting one is 409. The runner cannot put an outbound call on the phone (no published agent in its chain), so testCases[0] exercises the refusal for the test session's inbound call; the decisions are proven end-to-end.

testCases.name: Refuse AMD for an inbound call
A machine answers an active campaign call

errorCases.message: answered_by must be human, machine or unknown
answering-machine detection applies to outbound calls | answered_by was already recorded as <value> | call is <status>, not active
